race.description: Ladbrokes Turn On Flexi Multi Mdn Plate
race.comment: HELVECCHIO (2) resumes having run well on debut at Flemington, getting home nicely for a narrow fifth. He'll likely get further this time in but should take holding out in an easier contest. TUZEMAK (12) presents third up and can improve having tackled a stronger race in town last time behind an all the way winner. The fresh run reads well. VIKING KID (7) is a Wootton Bassett gelding for the Price & Kent Jnr yard who must be respected with Shinn booked, he was an expensive yearling and is worth keeping an eye on. AUTUMN RAINBOW (15) resumes having debuted in a good race in town, this suits better.
